wiki.summary: "Hydrogen Helium Lithium Leviathan" is the third track by Scottish electronic duo Boards of Canada for their studio album, Inferno. The track blends ambient, downtempo, and IDM with deep conceptual themes exploring the universe's creation and ancient mythology. Read more on Last.fm.
